reason: Verify remaining V1 acceptance against the current test/E2E baseline and required manual/notices evidence
Verify full Rust quality, secrets, dependencies, and core purity
Verify contract tests and live Tauri round-trip evidence
Verify cross-platform compile and typed Unsupported claims
Verify test semantics and accessible async UI

details: E2E fixture first error changed from retryable Network to non-retryable Stream so the UI retry scenario is observable; E2E config pins ui_language=zh and selectors match stable accessible elements. Bounded Windows rerun passed 7/7 after a scoped residual-process check.

pnpm test (155/155), pnpm build, cargo fmt, cargo clippy, cargo test --workspace, cargo build --workspace, and pnpm test:production-isolation passed. pnpm lint remains blocked by pre-existing .trellis/.backup-2026-08-30T03-31-02 statusline errors outside this task.

Added deterministic generator, cargo-about config/template, package script and CI drift check. cargo-about 0.6.6 is installed, but its first remote license harvest did not complete within the local check time bound; THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES was not fabricated and remains ungenerated.

Attempted three real-Tauri desktop cases before the refresh boundary: hotkey conflict/recovery, Rust event plus mocked selection, and mocked TTS start/stop. Both orderings produced 10 cases with 8 pass / 2 fail: service mocks did not intercept register_hotkeys or get_selection in the embedded provider. The experimental cases and E2E-only event command were reverted; artifacts/e2e contains the failure evidence. Do not treat the previous 7/7 suite as coverage for the missing hotkey/selection/TTS mock requirements.

cargo-about 0.9.2 CLI generator regenerated THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES twice with no diff; CI runs the same command then git diff --exit-code. ESLint now ignores only Trellis timestamped recovery snapshots (.trellis/.backup-*); pnpm lint passes.

Inspected final Windows JUnit artifact (10 tests, 0 failures; written 14:04 local). e2e_emit_translate_selection and e2e_emit_hotkey_status compile and register only with the e2e feature; default production handler and capability do not expose them. TTS test observes feature-gated speak/stop UI state only and makes no audible-output claim.

pnpm lint, pnpm build, pnpm test (23 files/155 tests), cargo fmt --all --check, cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings, cargo test --workspace (132 tests), cargo build --workspace, pnpm test:production-isolation, two pnpm notices:generate runs with THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES diff check, task validation, and git diff --check all passed.

Windows manual report records external selection, clipboard fallback, single-instance and idle-resource evidence. Audible SAPI, native tray menu actions, funded-provider latency, and remote three-platform CI remain unverified and are not claimed passed.
